description:
User ruling 2026-11-18, verbatim via Optimize, on page https://claude.ai/artifact/EDTPiu2As7pfX8DaBTXHUa: "1. whichever gets us there faster. 2. proceed." (decision 2).

Steps 2 and 3 of the fz-sc8.192.12 implementation plan:
- fz_flat_get is checked into bench/maps/floor, with a harness test.
- A case probe row with a BEAM twin: pinned lookups, at 12 and 40 keys, with atom and binary keys.
- One emitter for a map key test, used by native_codegen/prim.rs and receive.rs. It scans inline for atom/integer keys on a flat map, with fz_matcher_map_get_ref as the slow path.

Guard, judged on bench and pre-registered: the atom figures of the new row fall by at least 200 instructions per lookup, and no existing row rises. Builder: Optimize.
title: A map pattern's key test is the hand-written scan
